positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
TL of product engineering team. I built core products for millions of users including weekly credit pulls, AI debt negotiation, a credit disputes integration with a major credit bureau, and a MVNO phone plan service.

I joined around ~60 employees. We earned unicorn status ($160M -> $1.5B valuation) and grew rapidly to $300M+ ARR with strong profitability.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · MySQL · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
I worked on the prequalification product, which shows users their spending power. It 10x’d in gross merchandise volume during my time, and it now powers the Affirm Card (0 -> $20M+ ARR). Launched experiments and new core features (pay in 4, proactive prequal offers, internationalization / new markets). 

I touched credit underwriting, identity verification, declinations / AANs, and loan originations -- things that make the business still interesting today. I joined at around ~500 employees. IPO 2021 (AFRM).
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · MySQL · React · TypeScript
